title: I Love Jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I love the look of moonlight on the water
I love the sound of raindrops on the roof
I love a day when nothin's planned
And that summer feelin' of sand on my hands
And those moments when you tell the truth

[Pre-Chorus]
There's just one thing that's better than all that

[Chorus]
I love jazz
I love swing
I love playin' my guitar and when you sing
I love jump
I love jive
I love how it makes me feel so alive
So many things I love
But baby, more than anything, I love jazz

[Verse 2]
I love a good black-and-white movie
I love a cool breeze on a warm night
I love that time when you can start
To feel the change from summer to fall
And it all starts to feel just right

[Pre-Chorus]
There's just one thing that's better than all that

[Chorus]
I love jazz
I love swing
I love playin' my guitar and when you sing
I love jump
I love jive
I love how it makes me feel so alive
So many things I love
But baby, more than anything, I love jazz
[Bridge]
Jazz, the world would be so dull without you
I love jazz, I don't know what I would do
Without jazz, you're always there to pick me up
And take me outta this world, ooh
[Chorus]
I love jazz
I love swing
I love playin' my guitar and when you sing
I love jump
I love jive
I love how it makes me feel so alive
So many things I love
But baby, more than anything, I love jazz
